memoryBuilder.verseText: Then Jonah prayed unto the LORD his God out of the fish's belly.

sequence.prompt: What happened to Jonah? Put it in order.

items.label: God calls Jonah to go to Nineveh
Jonah runs away on a ship
Jonah prays and goes to Nineveh

matches.prompt: Match each to what they did.

pairs.right: Ran from God — then came back
Carried Jonah to a second chance
Waited for Jonah to come back

application.question: Jonah ran from God but God still used him! Have you ever done something wrong and then came back to God?

options.label: Yes — I came back to God
I told someone what I did
I am still learning to trust

application.followUp: No matter where you run, God is already there — and He is always ready to give you another chance, just like Jonah.
